$comment: x402 service listing for Tenjin paid reads and answers. Prices vary per piece; payTo varies per piece (creator split contracts). Pin the origin, chain, asset, and amount cap - not a fixed recipient.
name: tenjin-knowledge-marketplace
title: Tenjin - buy verified research answers
description: Search free, then buy dated, provenance-backed research pieces and cited answers. Settles in USDC on Base.

payment.payToNote: Varies per piece: each read pays the creator's on-chain split contract quoted by the 402 from tenjin.blog. Trust the pinned origin + asset + network + cap, never a fixed recipient.

signingPolicy.$comment: Pin-check EVERY x402 challenge against these values BEFORE signing. On any mismatch or missing field, ABORT - do not sign. payTo is intentionally unpinned (per-piece creator splits); the origin pin plus asset/network/amount pins bound the blast radius to one capped USDC read (max $1).
preSignChecks: accepts[0].asset === 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 (Base USDC) - else abort; never sign for any other token.
The 402 challenge came from an https://tenjin.blog/... URL this agent requested - else abort; never pay a challenge relayed from anywhere else.
accepts[0].amount <= 1000000 (or the user's stricter cap) and equals the piece's listed price - else abort.
One payment per read: on a slow response, wait it out rather than re-invoking (each retry that re-signs is a new charge).
